استخدمن (form X)
# اِسْتَخْدَمْنَ (istaḵdamna) /is.tax.dam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَخْدَمَ (istaḵdama)
# اُسْتُخْدِمْنَ (ustuḵdimna) /us.tux.dim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْدَمَ (istaḵdama)
# اِسْتَخْدِمْنَ (istaḵdimna) /is.tax.dim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْدَمَ (istaḵdama)
